content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The Internship Programme of the Department of Expenditure is a Central Sector Scheme [E01] that aims to familiarize willing and eligible undergraduates pursuing five-year integrated courses and Graduates pursuing post-Graduation/post-Graduates pursuing Research with the overall process of formulation of economic policies of the Government [E01]. The internship is neither a job nor any assurance for a job in the Department [E01]. The duration ranges from two to six months at different points during the financial year [E01]. Interns receive token remuneration of ₹10,000 per month, payable upon satisfactory completion and submission of their Report/Paper [E01]. They are provided with office space and a computer with internet facility [E01], and are attached with DS/Director level officers in different Divisions based on their areas of interest [E01]. Interns must furnish a declaration of secrecy before reporting [E01] and present a Report/Paper on their allotted subject at the end of the internship [E02].
